fusions.name: Lobbed Bough
fusions.desc: Throws a burning branch at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 13 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. It knocks the target back 2.5 tiles and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Knuckles Aflame
fusions.desc: Pounds the ground with burning fists, which deals 8 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and sets each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Brandished Torch
fusions.desc: Increases your fire damage by 25% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Kindled Cudgel
fusions.desc: Conjures a burning branch to wield as a club. It increases your weapon damage by 12%, and every strike with it sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
